after.label: Can reach (to measure)

scenes.caption: Our hypothesis, not Oppy's claim. Built from public pages; nothing tested.
say: We would write down each agent's mandate, then measure what its credentials actually reach.
The place to look: an agent that may draft but can reach a send path.

scenes.title: Synergy 2: evidence for Oppy's customers
steps: Oppy hands the evidence to its customers
scenes.caption: What we would do together: turn a tight agentic workflow into proof customers can hold.
say: Customers are handing Oppy their CRM and their prospects' contact details.
Evidence of a tight workflow is something Oppy could show them, not just assert.

scenes.title: Synergy 3: agents Oppy deploys into customers' environments
scenes.caption: Illustration of what we would map. Which links exist is unknown from public pages.
say: An agent sitting in a customer's environment holds that customer's data.
We would secure it by mandating and measuring it, so the question marks become answers.

scenes.title: Three synergies, each grounded in Oppy's own pages
rows: Drafted outreach; CRM sync; contact enrichment
LinkedIn and WhatsApp messaging; workflow automation

Mandate and measure in the customer's environment
scenes.caption: Middle column is Oppy's public description; right column is our proposal.
say: Three angles, one method: write the mandate, measure the reach, record the gap.

scenes.text: An agent that may draft should be provably unable to send, and Oppy could be the one who proves it.
scenes.caption: A hypothesis from public pages only. We would test it together.
say: That is the offer in one line, and we would check it with Oppy, not claim it for them.

items: £500 · ABP Tailored: your deployment, reflected in the mandate, corrected by a named security professional (1 to 3 days)
£1,500 · ABP Reviewed: two sessions with your team and a custom vault, signed off by a security professional (1 to 5 days)
£5,000 · A deeper engagement: your agents mapped, mandated and measured with us, end to end
Summit promotion: commit today and take 25% off any of these, or, with the £1,500 or £5,000 package, a tablet set up for you.
